|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Molator (V) (Virtual Set 2)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Your characters present about to be lost during battle (before the damage segment) remain in play and must be forfeited (for 0) at end of battle. Characters of ability < 5 are immune to Goo Nee Tay. [Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. If your character in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Characters of ability < 5 are immune to Goo Nee Tay. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “Your characters present” → “If your character in battle is”; “during battle (before” → “before”; “segment) remain in play and must be forfeited (for 0)” → “segment, it is instead lost”; “battle.” → “battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0).”; “[Immune” → “(Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards2.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 4, slip 42. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Molator]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour#Cards|Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
